title: COP31气候谈判未达成协议 化石燃料分歧成焦点
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: We could not, with any good conscience, support to text that effectively denies what is happening in the world and was hijacked by fossil fuel producers.
segments.zh: 我们无法凭良心支持一份实质上否认世界现状、并被化石燃料生产国劫持的文本。

segments.en: How can we actually accept a text that doesn't even reference transitioning away fossil fuel?
segments.zh: 我们怎能接受一份甚至不提摆脱化石燃料的文本？

segments.en: How ridiculous is that? Ireland's climate minister Dara O'Brien speaking after international climate talks collapsed without a major agreement.
segments.zh: 这有多荒谬？爱尔兰气候部长达拉·奥布莱恩在国际气候谈判未达成重大协议后表示。

segments.en: Dozens of countries rejected a deal at COP31 in Turkey, EU countries, among those that refused to endorse the package with the blocks.
segments.zh: 数十个国家在土耳其COP31上拒绝了一项协议，欧盟国家也拒绝支持该一揽子方案。

segments.en: Top climate negotiators saying it would have meant the world backsliding on its commitment to transition away from fossil fuels.
segments.zh: 顶级气候谈判代表表示，这将意味着世界在摆脱化石燃料的承诺上倒退。

segments.en: Our EU Energy and Climate Reporters at John Andrews in Antalya and Turkey for the summit and joins us live now.
segments.zh: 我们的欧盟能源与气候记者约翰·安德鲁斯在土耳其安塔利亚峰会现场，现在连线。

segments.en: John, what went wrong in these talks? Well, as you said, I mean talks ran deep into overtime.
segments.zh: 约翰，这些谈判出了什么问题？正如你所说，谈判严重超时。

segments.en: This was the longest COP climate summit on record and really they collapsed in the end due to a big protracted fight over fossil fuels
segments.zh: 这是有史以来最长的COP气候峰会，最终因化石燃料问题上的持久争执而破裂。

segments.en: and how those were being referenced in the proposed decision text.
segments.zh: 以及这些内容在拟议决定文本中如何被提及。

segments.en: The main issue surrounds the agreement that was made a couple of years ago to transition away from fossil fuels, and agreement which many countries, many petrostates have been trying to basically backtrack away from,
segments.zh: 主要问题围绕几年前达成的摆脱化石燃料的协议，许多国家、许多石油国家一直试图基本上背弃该协议。

segments.en: and we saw that kind of get onto the plenary floor yesterday.
segments.zh: 昨天我们看到这类情况进入了全会讨论。
